title.en: Lath and plaster names the sections; concrete pump mixing seal φ80 keeps the printed cells
title.zh: 《Lath and plaster》只提供章节，concrete pump mixing seal φ80仍用已印格子

description.en: The concrete pump mixing seal φ80 note follows the outline of Lath and plaster. The φ80 mixing seal is a set on the Xingtai mixing-seal page for concrete pumps and mixer pumps. Confirm this outer diameter on the mixer. The page does not say which published mixer pump uses φ80.
description.zh: concrete pump mixing seal φ80这篇笔记顺着《Lath and plaster》的大纲写。φ80 搅拌密封是邢台搅拌密封页上的一套，用于混凝土泵和搅拌泵。请在搅拌装置上核对这一外径。页面没有写哪一台已公布搅拌泵使用 φ80。

h1.en: How Lath and plaster arranges a note that only repeats concrete pump mixing seal φ80
h1.zh: 《Lath and plaster》怎样安排一篇只重复concrete pump mixing seal φ80的笔记

directAnswer.en: For concrete pump mixing seal φ80, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Lath and plaster. Lath and plaster only lends its headings. The φ80 mixing seal is a set on the Xingtai mixing-seal page for concrete pumps and mixer pumps. Confirm this outer diameter on the mixer. The page does not say which published mixer pump uses φ80.
directAnswer.zh: 写concrete pump mixing seal φ80时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《Lath and plaster》借数字。《Lath and plaster》只出借标题。 φ80 搅拌密封是邢台搅拌密封页上的一套，用于混凝土泵和搅拌泵。请在搅拌装置上核对这一外径。页面没有写哪一台已公布搅拌泵使用 φ80。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Description”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Sizes on the page: φ65, φ80, and generation kits (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th) plus an upper-pump kit. Those generation rows and the upper-pump row do not print an extra outer diameter. This note is only φ80. Unit: set. Material and life are missing. Integrated Mixer Pump prints 45 kW / 14 kW, a 400 or 500 mixer note, and pipe 100 / 125 mm. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints a 400 or 500 mixer note and no pipe diameter. Neither page names φ65 or φ80. φ80 on this page is a mixing seal. It is not the DN80 clamp, not the Electric 20 pipe cell, and not the S-tube small-end seal at φ80. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write mixing seal φ80 and the quantity in sets. Do not substitute a generation kit unless that is the row you checked. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“描述”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 页面尺寸：φ65、φ80，以及第一代至第四代套件和上泵套件。分代行和上泵行没有另印外径。本文只写 φ80。单位：套。材料和寿命缺失。 搅拌泵一体机印了 45 kW / 14 kW、400 或 500 搅拌的说明，以及管子 100 / 125 mm。柴油搅拌泵一体机印了 400 或 500 搅拌的说明，没有管径。两页都没有写 φ65 或 φ80。 这一页的 φ80 是搅拌密封。它不是 DN80 管卡，不是电动20的管径格，也不是 S 管小端 φ80 密封。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明搅拌密封 φ80 和套数。除非核对到的就是分代那一行，否则不要改成分代套件。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: The heading “Historical transition” is structural. What it is allowed to carry is the wording already on the row for this note. The φ80 mixing seal is a set on the Xingtai mixing-seal page for concrete pumps and mixer pumps. Confirm this outer diameter on the mixer. The page does not say which published mixer pump uses φ80. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. Stop when the printed fragment stops.
body.zh: 标题“来源章节：Historical transition”只起骨架作用。它能够携带的，是这篇笔记对应那一行已经印出的文字。 φ80 搅拌密封是邢台搅拌密封页上的一套，用于混凝土泵和搅拌泵。请在搅拌装置上核对这一外径。页面没有写哪一台已公布搅拌泵使用 φ80。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 印出的片段结束，这句话也结束。

body.en: “Advantages” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 搅拌密封 page plus this size and the quantity. Unprinted cells stay unprinted. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lath_and_plaster
body.zh: “优点”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明搅拌密封这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 没有印出的格子保持不印。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lath_and_plaster

answer.en: This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The heading and the source photograph do not add a further figure.
answer.zh: 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 章节标题和来源图片都不另加数字。
